name: Vigil arsenal: VW2 detailed weapon set
revision: 0.2 · VW2 series 0.2: 16 detailed weapons, every engraved detail at or over the 0.4 mm resin limit, bolted plates, signature hardware
description: Second-generation Vigilant weapons, much more detailed than VW-01..08: VW2-01 Glaive service rifle (rail laser), VW2-02 Quarrel carbine, VW2-03 Bodkin marksman rifle (scope sunshade, bipod), VW2-04 Ranseur grenadier rifle, VW2-05 Thresher drum shotgun, VW2-06 Rondel PDW, VW2-07 Culverin heavy revolver (charge cell), VW2-08 Awl service pistol (rail light), VW2-09 Partisan LMG, VW2-10 Arbalest rail rifle (coil windings, charge lenses), VW2-11 Censer plasma projector (sight-glass), VW2-12 Ballista launcher (strakes, fire-control box, carry handle), VW2-13 Misericorde combat knife, VW2-14 Crowbill breaching tool, VW2-15 Cinder grenade, VW2-16 Petard breaching charge. 0.5 mm V-groove panel lines, 0.46 mm vents with 0.45 mm lands, bolted access plates, bolt carriers in the ejection ports, round-count studs, cooling rings and lenses; every recess measured to resolve at 0.4 mm.
buildNotes: Defined in tools/arsenal.py (WEAPONS2 registry, VW2-01..16); built by tools/bitspack.py on a 0.05 mm SDF grid; display sheets by source/sheet.py.
Every pistol grip is the VW grip block (1.0 x 1.1 x 2.0 mm at the origin), so figures hold VW2 weapons with the existing gauntlets.

0.2: panel lines are 0.5 mm 90-degree V-grooves, vents 0.46 mm with 0.45 mm lands, rail teeth 0.45 mm with 0.55 mm gaps; raised plates, bolts, lenses and cooling rings carry most of the new detail (raised detail needs only 0.1 mm).
Measured with unified-CAD-MCP miniature_detail_resolution_check (new in this revision): 0 recesses fill in on any part; see reports/printability.md and DESIGN-LOG.md.
limitations: Procedural designs; printability and detail are heuristic screens (unified-CAD-MCP), not a test print. Print meshes are simplified by manifold3d only as far as the 280k-triangle check budget needs (tolerance in reports/build.json). The assembly STEP is an envelope reference re-meshed at 0.35 mm (about 1,000-1,600 triangles per weapon): it does not carry the fine detail; the print STLs do.

mini.process: MSLA resin · 8K 7-inch class MSLA (e.g. Elegoo Saturn/Mars class)
